response.justification: Bogdan is a highly skilled Staff/Senior Software Engineer with strong distributed systems and open-source experience, but he lacks the executive leadership background required for a CTO role. He does not have a track record of scaling engineering organizations from 10 to 30+ people, lacks deep production experience with multi-agent AI systems in high-stakes financial environments, and has not demonstrated experience managing external delivery partners or communicating with a board of directors.
strengths: Strong background in backend and distributed systems, including microservices, event-driven architectures, and high-volume request handling.
Recent exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) workflows.
Prior exposure to the fintech sector through his software development work at RIDE Capital.
concerns: Complete lack of executive-level engineering leadership experience, such as scaling teams from 10 to 30+ people and developing technical leadership layers.
Insufficient production experience operating complex, stateful multi-agent AI systems in regulated or high-stakes commercial environments.
No demonstrated experience managing outsourced engineering models, setting security baselines, or framing technical trade-offs for a board.
